select count(*) from goods_info where del = 0 and supply_id = #{supplyId} and sale_state = #{saleState}
SELECT count(*) as cot,create_id,u.nick_name FROM goods_info a INNER JOIN sys_user u on u.user_id = a.create_id WHERE a.sale_state = 1 GROUP BY a.create_id
select count(*) from goods_info where del=0 and sale_state=3 and to_days(now())-to_days(saletime) = 1
where del=0 and sale_state=3 and DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) <= date(saletime) ORDER BY saletime desc

SELECT count(*) cot,game_name as type FROM goods_info WHERE del = 0
AND sale_state = #{saleState}
AND TO_DAYS(create_time)=TO_DAYS(NOW())
GROUP BY game_id ORDER BY cot desc

SELECT game_name AS type, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_state=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as weishou, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_state=6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as zhaohui, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_state=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as wenti FROM goods_info WHERE del = 0 GROUP BY game_id ORDER BY weishou desc

select sum(price) 'totalGoodsPrice',sum(cost_price) 'totalGoodsCostPrice' ,count(1) 'costGoodsCount' from goods_info where create_id = #{createId} and sale_state =#{saleState} and del =0 and gs_state = '1'
